hypothesis: Cross-view label disagreement contains correct-class evidence lost by a fixed-label coordinate policy; observer context may help decide which label to trust.
stage: Cached annotation-assisted headroom only, not a deployable result or novelty confirmation.
sample: First256 of the1610 previously viewed test-dev images sorted by SHA256('class-conflict-preflight-v1:'+stem). No result-dependent sample.
baseline: Frozen fixed seed0 uniform coordinates, calibrated scores and count.
label_actions: Keep original class; alternatively any class supported by a cached view box of IoU>=0.7 and raw confidence>=0.05. At most one maximum score*IoU contribution per class per view.
ordinary_control: Weighted cross-view class vote: sum maximum score*IoU per view; prefer original class on exact tie; keep original when no evidence. No learned parameters.
oracle: Class-agnostic IoU>=0.5 score-ordered one-to-one original ownership; set owned class to that GT only if already present in valid label actions; unowned rows keep original class.
diagnostic_ignore: All actions and predictions constructed without GT. Apply max individual ignored-box IoF>0.5 only afterwards, equally to all arms. Not official VisDrone preprocessing.
interpretation: Three conditions only permit a small train-scene-held-out class-choice pilot. Ordinary voting gains alone are not a novel mechanism. Negative result ends this label-action menu.
limits: Oracle may alter global matching and is not an AP upper bound; physical GT ownership is a geometry proxy. Reused sampled test-dev proposes a hypothesis, not independent confirmation. Fixed confidence recall/FP are not official AP/AR.
budget: No image decoding, detector inference, training or official evaluation; one sampled cached pass.
prior_art: Class fusion already appears in FUSE(KDD2021); multiscale learned fusion/rescoring appears in FUSEye(arXiv2610.02799v1,2026-10-02). Context-dependent class trust remains only a candidate requiring closer comparison.
